Titel: Head of Group Risk Management & Internal Control (m/f/d)
Unternehmen: Norvik Industrial Holding SE
Ort: Hanover, Lower Saxony, Germany (On-site)
Quelle: LinkedIn
Link: https://www.linkedin.com/jobs/view/4185730918/
Abgerufen am: 21.09.2026 18:20

About the job
Norvik Industrial Holding SE is a listed group of industrial companies with about 11,000 employees in 23 countries, active in drive technology, pumps and building services. We are looking for a Head of Group Risk Management & Internal Control who reports directly to the CFO.

Your tasks
Lead the group functions for enterprise risk management and the internal control system with a team of 5
Develop the risk early warning system in line with Section 91 (3) AktG and IDW PS 981 and 982
Prepare the quarterly risk report for the Executive Board and the Audit Committee
Integrate ESG risks into the risk inventory, aligned with the double materiality assessment under the CSRD
Coordinate with Internal Audit, Compliance and the external auditors
Select and roll out a group-wide GRC tool

Your profile
Degree in business administration, law or a comparable field
10+ years in risk management, internal control or audit, a Big Four background is welcome
Several years of leadership experience
Sound knowledge of COSO ERM, COSO Internal Control and ISO 31000
Confident when presenting to the board and the Audit Committee
Fluent German and English

What we offer
Permanent position, full-time
Attractive package including bonus, company car and company pension scheme
Relocation support to Hanover

Seniority level: Director
Employment type: Full-time
